task: the build workflow and every role; Fable 5.2 advice
brief: Owner, 2026-11-25: Claude usage reset weekly; use Anthropic where appropriate but mix in OpenCode Go and zero-cost models; Fable 5.2 is the product owner's default again; when the lead is consistently stuck, consult Fable 5.2 blind with minimal context and have it delegate finding and reading.
tradeoff: Free OpenCode Go builders and QA may be weaker than Sonnet 5.5, and a host that cannot reach them needs a documented fallback. Fable advice costs its input and output, so it sees only the question and the minimum evidence and delegates reading to cheaper models.
entry: Refine and Check on claude-agent/opus high; Spec, architecture, adversarial and UX on claude-agent/sonnet high; Build/Fix and helpers on OpenCode Go hy4-flash-free; QA on OpenCode Go beam-free; product owner and advisor on claude-agent/fable high. The Claude Agent provider uses the weekly allowance, not the Anthropic API balance. A host that cannot reach an OpenCode model runs that role on claude-agent/sonnet and records the substitution. The advisor is blind, gets minimal context, and must use Task to delegate any finding or reading to cheaper models.
serves: PRODUCT.md quality bar; the weekly model budget; 'A claim of working means a real client or a real store exercised it.'
